Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 653 AM EDT Wed Oct 28 2026

- Mild temperatures return today and continue Thursday with highs in
  the 70s. These high temperatures are 10 to 15 degrees above 
  normal. 

- There is a chance of showers Thursday afternoon and Thursday night.

- Dry and continued mild Friday.

&&

.AVIATION...

Early morning observations indicate a warm front extending eastward 
from Midwest low pressure to very near the west end of Lake Erie at 
forecast issuance. Easterly flow just ahead of the front and off the 
Lake lifted surface Td into the lower 50s at KTOL and KTTF which 
presents a short time window for MVFR fog/stratus as mid level 
clouds strip away and before the front moves quickly northward. SW 
surface wind traces the onset of VFR warm sector conditions under 
patchy mid and high clouds and late day shallow cumulus. These 
clouds also exit eastward or dissipate leaving clear sky and mild SW 
wind this evening. The eastern fringe of mid level clouds associated 
with the Midwest cold move in late tonight and the cold front 
approaches the MBS area toward sunrise Thursday. 

D21/DTW Convection... Thunderstorms are not forecast through the TAF 
period.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...
